desc:
Survive Bloop and avoid becoming a sea creature's meal! 
The dangerous denizens of the deep are wreaking havoc on ships and citizens alike.

If you encounter any glitches or exploiters, report them in our group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/8156679/X-Studio#!/about

Update: Old models, bloop and scp shark have their old models back.

Stay tuned for exciting updates Give the game a thumbs up to show your support and receive more thrilling updates. 

Keep in mind that the game might have occasional bugs or glitches. 

This is the authentic Bloop game—beware of imitations!

Original Bloop game
